Best for

  • Hotels, hospitals, offices and large homes with many rooms
  • Buildings where each zone needs its own temperature control
  • Projects that want central control and lower running costs than many separate splits

How to choose

  • One VRF outdoor unit connects to many indoor units, each controlled separately.
  • Indoor units come in wall, low-height ceiling, high air quantity ceiling, and 1, 2 and 4-way cassette types.
  • Central control stations (such as PSC-AD128EX) let you manage every unit from one place.
  • VRF needs design up front: we size the outdoor units, piping and zones for your building.

Questions about Hitachi VRF Systems

What is a VRF system?

A VRF (variable refrigerant flow) system connects one or more outdoor units to many indoor units, varying the refrigerant to each room so every zone can be cooled to its own setting. It suits hotels, hospitals, offices and large homes.

Which Hitachi VRF models do you supply?

Hitachi Set Free Sigma outdoor units from 8 to 24 HP, wall, ceiling and cassette indoor units, an AHU kit, and wired remotes and central control stations.

Do Hitachi VRF systems work in high temperatures?

The Set Free Sigma range is listed for a tropical ambient operating range up to 52°C.
